programme.title: Guardians of the Wild
programme.desc: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But a small, dedicated team are fighting to keep them safe. This is the frontline of conservation – it doesn’t get any tougher.
